summary: The scene earns its restraint through concrete institutional images (the doubled signature, the two grey file-covers two fingers apart, the faceless reflection in the blind tin door), but it repeatedly undercuts those images by adding a flat explanatory sentence right after them, most damagingly in the closing line that states the theme the mirror image just enacted.

issues.unit: Der Fall Aebischer war abgeschlossen, wie der Fall Vogel
issues.fix_hint: Delete the final sentence; end on 'schloss die Tür zum Keller ab.' The two file-covers and the faceless reflection already said this.

issues.unit: Sie gingen jeder in seine Richtung, und keiner
issues.fix_hint: Cut the sentence beginning 'Sie gingen jeder in seine Richtung'; the prior two sentences already show them parting.

issues.unit: Keiner sagte, was zwischen ihnen stand
issues.fix_hint: Cut 'Keiner sagte, was zwischen ihnen stand.'; the silence and the loose leaf against the wall already carry it.

issues.unit: es kalt geworden, der Himmel ... farblos
issues.fix_hint: Cut 'kalt geworden' and 'farblos'; stock weather that carries no charge specific to this street, this man.
